description: i018 (timer-dwork-softirq-lock, snapshot s03) finalized as an evidence-backed negative result with one safe classification and three bounded unresolved leads. METHOD: scripted enumeration over 16,667 .c files under drivers/, net/, kernel/, mm/, fs/, block/, ipc/, security/, lib/ matched 741 distinct timer-list callback names (timer_setup/setup_timer/DEFINE_TIMER/init_timer) and body-scanned each callback for a plain spin_lock; exactly one timer callback body contained one: net/sunrpc/xprt.c xprt_init_autodisconnect (def :697-714, registered setup_timer(&xprt->timer, xprt_init_autodisconnect, ...) at :1375) taking plain spin_lock(&xprt->transport_lock) at :702 (unlock :709/:713). TRIAGED SAFE with literal evidence: plain acquisition is correct on the TIMER_SOFTIRQ side, and every one of the 14 sibling transport_lock acquisitions in xprt.c uses spin_lock_bh/spin_unlock_bh (:275/:277, :381/:383, :516/:522, :599/:601, :631/:634, :646/:652, :669/:680, :722/:731, :737/:746, :900/:906, :922/:942, :970/:976, :995/:1020, :1289/:1297), including the workqueue worker xprt_autoclose (INIT_WORK(&xprt->task_cleanup, xprt_autoclose) at :1373, locks :631/:646/:669) that the timer callback itself queues at :710 — the process/workqueue holder side always disables bottom halves, so the missing-BH invariant holds for this lock. NO CREDIBLE FINDING was confirmed in s03 for this branch. Bounded limitations recorded in the artifact (agent-state/findings/i018.json, snapshots_checked=["s03"], execution_status=complete, findings=[], 4 candidates): (1) the function-body extractor only matched split-line definitions, so single-line definitions (e.g. 'static void br_multicast_group_expired(struct timer_list *t) {') were never body-scanned, leaving net/bridge/br_multicast.c (br->multicast_lock; confirmed vulnerable family in sibling s07, fact f015) and drivers/scsi/libiscsi.c (session->frwd_lock; confirmed vulnerable family in sibling s05, fact f016) UNVERIFIED in s03 and highest-priority follow-up; (2) hrtimer handlers, indirect function-pointer timers, delayed_work bodies, arch/sound/crypto/virt trees, and qdisc root_lock timers (sch_pie/sch_sfq/sch_red) were not enumerated; (3) transport_lock siblings in sock_xprt.c/xprtrdma were not checked (two grep attempts failed on cwd/rg permission before the halt); (4) static analysis only, no build/lockdep. The ks7010 seed (s03 ks7010_sdio.c:374) is xmit-shaped and excluded per the never-report-the-seed rule.
